scope: Historical local development experiment only; no current forecast, live changes or promotion.
baseline: Original 53 frozen15h latency predictors and original ridge implementation; no centering change, anomaly masks or2023 augmentation.
additional_features: ONS val_nivelmontante and val_niveljusante for each of julho,monte,castro: delayed level, change1h, slope3h, slope6h. level_and_slopes appends24 columns; slopes_only appends18 change/slope columns. Levels are meters, without conversion to storage or subtraction between different gauges.
availability: Assume UTC-03 and60min publication delay, as-of age at most90min after delayed lookup. Preserve23:59 source time as recorded, never relabel as midnight. Actual historical publication/version history is unavailable; this is a development assumption, not prospective proof.
quality: Keep all finite numeric values, including zero and negatives, and report anomalies separately. A nonfinite newest observation remains missing and must not be bypassed by an earlier finite value. Reject duplicate plant/time keys. Fit imputation and scaling on training rows only.
response: target-known, restore known before nonnegative output clipping, identical for all families
selection: No tuning. Compare MAE,bias,P90 overall and high-flow at source95th-percentile threshold before validation; identical target pairs required. Mean across leads of validation MAEall+0.5MAEhigh is a diagnostic selection score only. Preserve every result; all periods already examined are development, not fresh independent holdout.
